# C62DirLi

**Author:** Skrip<br/>
**Platforms:** ODM

<div className="screenshot">

![C62DirLi: screenshot 1](./c62dirli/img/c62dirli.png)

</div>

C62DirLi edits XML directory lists of the Siemens C62 file system. Using them, you can change file and directory attributes, open hidden folders, and allow reading, writing, or deleting objects via OBEX.

Flash Programmer is used to retrieve and write back the lists. Version 1.3 can remove the "read-only" attribute and, if necessary, launches `C62MdmUn.exe` to switch the phone to service mode.
